title: Junior AI / NLP Engineer
description: Build and evaluate transformer models for multilingual NLP. PyTorch, Hugging Face, LoRA/PEFT, dataset pipelines, and benchmark reporting (F1, bias analysis). Python required; research-to-production experience a plus.

title: AI Software Engineer Intern (Multi-Agent / RAG)
description: Design multi-agent workflows with RAG, OCR, SQL tool-use, and output guardrails for government clients. Python, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, and production LLM pipelines. Security-conscious engineering expected.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (New Grad / Junior)
description: Ship full-stack features with React, Node.js/TypeScript, REST APIs, and PostgreSQL. Deploy on AWS (S3, EC2). Testing, CI/CD, and Agile collaboration required.

title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
description: Train and deploy classification models on real-time data. PyTorch, data preprocessing, evaluation, and presenting results to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Healthcare or applied ML project experience preferred.

title: Backend Software Engineer Intern
description: Build Python/Node APIs and real-time data aggregation services. SQL, schema validation, AWS deployment, and documented system architecture. Interest in operational decision-support systems is a plus.

title: NLP Research Intern

title: Federal Consulting Technologist Intern

title: Unity / Simulation Engineer Intern
description: Build VR/simulation experiences in Unity (C#) with custom AI (behavior trees) and physics interactions. Game jam or shipped prototype experience preferred.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Analyze datasets, write SQL, build dashboards, and present insights to non-technical leadership. Excel/Tableau preferred; Python data processing is acceptable.

title: DevOps / Cloud Engineer Intern
description: CI/CD, AWS infrastructure, Docker/Kubernetes, Terraform. Some Git and cloud deploy experience expected; deep infra-as-code is the core of the role.
